spells.name: Reap
spells.description: Strike for 90% normalized weapon damage plus 3 Physical damage. A damaging hit generates 7 to 13 Runic Power and a Soul Fragment.

spells.name: Murder
spells.description: Deal 13 to 14 Shadow damage, plus 1 per level through level 6 and 18% of attack power. With Soul Collector, a hit grants a Reaped Soul. Reduces melee hit chance by 3% for 10 seconds. Costs 30 Runic Power.

spells.name: Soul Strike
spells.description: Strike for 75% normalized weapon damage plus 3 Shadow damage. A hit grants a Reaped Soul and heals you for 80% of damage dealt plus 10% of your missing health. Costs 40 Runic Power.

spells.name: Soulrend
spells.description: Requires Soul Infusion. Deal 17 to 18 Shadow damage plus 36% of attack power and 29.7% of Shadow spell power. Consumes all souls, fragments and infusion. A hit generates 15 Runic Power. Miss, dodge and parry preserve infusion.

spells.name: Soul Collector
spells.description: Reap generates a Soul Fragment when it deals damage. Three fragments become one Reaped Soul. Murder also grants a soul on hit. Three souls grant Soul Infusion, enabling Soulrend. Soul resources clear on death or logout.

spells.name: Soul Fragment
spells.description: Three Soul Fragments become one Reaped Soul. Expires after 30 seconds. Clears on death or logout.

spells.name: Reaped Soul
spells.description: Three Reaped Souls grant Soul Infusion. Soulrend consumes all souls and fragments. Clears on death or logout.

spells.name: Soul Infusion
spells.description: Soulrend is available. It consumes your souls, fragments and infusion. Clears on death or logout.

adaptations: First rank only; complete kit at level 6.
Soulrend gain of 15 RP is provisional retail tuning, not established official CoA tuning.
Soul resources clear on death/logout; native RP remains native.
Atomic thresholds replace the reconstruction periodic synchronization.
Native retail visuals/icons reused; no client executable patch.
